title: Lateralus
description: A 5×5 dot-grid font: every letter and numeral, a type tester, and controls for the dots.

title: Color and food
description: Move across the canvas: x picks a color, y picks a food.

title: Tilt cursor
description: Tilt your phone to steer a CAD crosshair, with the live gyro numbers on screen.

title: Sticky notes
description: A pad of sticky notes on every page: peel one off, stick it anywhere, type until it's full.

title: Packaging collector
description: Photograph the six sides of a box: each panel is found, flattened and folded back into a 3D box you can turn around.
